## Core Growth Services
1. **Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)**: High-converting video reels, carousel creatives, pin-code localized demographic targeting, A/B split testing, and weekly ROAS scaling.
2. **Google Ads (Search, Display & YouTube PPC)**: Buyer-intent keyword bidding, negative keyword optimization, call-only ad funnels, and conversion tracking.
3. **Google Maps Business Listing Optimization (Local SEO)**: Google Business Profile claim and verification, 3-Pack local ranking, geo-tagged photo uploads, and automated 5-star customer review collection.
4. **Social Media Account Handling (Facebook & Instagram)**: Monthly content calendar, bilingual (Hindi & English) graphic design and reels, daily inbox engagement, and brand trust building.
5. **YouTube Channel Handling & Video Production**: Studio recording consultation, high-CTR thumbnail design, search-optimized video titles, tags, and description SEO.
6. **Business Automation Agents & WhatsApp Bots**: Official WhatsApp Cloud API chatbots, instant 30-second lead qualification, FAQ automation, and real-time Google Sheets & CRM synchronization.
7. **Custom Website Development**: Next.js mobile-first business websites with sub-second page load speeds, 100/100 Google PageSpeed scores, and one-click WhatsApp/Call CTAs.
8. **Mobile & Web App Development (Android & iOS)**:
   - E-Commerce & Quick Delivery Apps (UPI & payment gateway integration, cart recovery, live map tracking).
   - Coaching, LMS & Education Apps (DRM anti-piracy video streaming, mock tests, fee payments).

   - Business ERP & Field Staff Apps (GPS attendance, mobile invoicing, offline sync).
   - On-Demand Delivery & Services Apps (Customer, rider, and admin dispatcher apps).
   - Custom SaaS & Cloud Portals (Multi-tenant portals, subscription billing, analytics).
